description: The site for BIASADRA, an Irish AI academy that places students into partner universities. Students browse programmes by country (Ireland, the UK, Germany, France, Spain, the Netherlands, the USA and Canada) and subject, compare duration, fees and intake dates, and apply.
contributions: Built the site in Next.js and TypeScript
Built programme pages for eight countries and the EU, each listing programmes with duration, tuition fees and intake dates
Built subject areas (AI, energy, health and art), about, contact and sign-in
results: Programmes in 8 countries on one site
Duration, fees and intakes comparable at a glance

body.heading: The brief
paragraphs: BIASADRA connects students with universities across Europe and North America. The site had to let a student find a programme in the country they want, in the subject they want, and see what it costs and when it starts, without a PDF brochure per university.

body.heading: What I built
paragraphs: A page per country listing its partner programmes with duration, tuition and intake dates in the same layout, so they can be compared directly; subject pages for AI, energy, health and art; and the about, contact and sign-in pages. BIASADRA is a sister company of HitoAI, whose platform I also built.
